description: Who launched this token, and what happened to their other tokens? A creator's launch record on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana from our own history of new pools: every token the wallet launched since 2026-10-23 with its risk score at launch and whether its liquidity was gone 24 hours and 7 days later, plus a verdict (repeat-rugger, prior-rug, serial-launcher, clean-so-far, too-new). Pass the deployer wallet or a token address. Not advice. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: The deployer wallet, or a token address (then its deployer is looked up)

chain.description: Chain; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

name: deployer_record
